items.lede: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]
items.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks

items.lede: The FBI says that the open-source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.
items.title: FBI says Artex AI open-source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’

items.lede: Artex and similar penetration testing tools allow newbie hackers to scan targeted systems for vulnerabilities and successfully wage attacks using prompts fed to chatbots.
items.title: Artex Is Criminals’ New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
